scope: One browser-portable single-peer room endpoint and its Node compatibility pair only. Local HTTP/WebSocket transport and Worker/A2 contract evidence; no browser-owned peer, Internet, two-machine, complete-set, deployment, WebRTC, rollback, gameplay accuracy, or performance claim.

pre_change_reproducer.server: Real node:http upgrade and raw WebSocket frames over TCP; READY and opaque first hello were written together to each of two sockets.
pre_change_reproducer.cleanup_note: Both client endpoints and the server were confirmed closed. The recorded transport errors occurred during deliberate socket destruction in final cleanup, not during the delivery assertion.

implementation_contract.single_peer_api: createRoomRelayPeerEndpoint returns synchronously with role, ready, send, onMessage, close, and drainInbound; the initial receiver is installed before the return and before readiness can expose remote packets.
implementation_contract.readiness: READY is transport control, never an A2 message. Outbound A2 sends wait for endpoint readiness.
implementation_contract.pair_compatibility: openRoomRelayPeerPair composes two endpoint handles and retains early data in the existing bounded serialized receive lane until callers subscribe.
implementation_contract.pair_close: All concurrent and repeated close callers share one cached promise, including its rejection when an awaited callback fails.

runtime.worker_test_runtime: Wrangler 4.131.1, Miniflare 5.20260911.0-alpha, workerd 1.20260911.1; direct Miniflare disposal and process-group cleanup passed.
